definitions.explanation: An exam given to students who missed the original exam or failed to pass, often due to illness or other valid reasons.

examples.japanese: {追試|ついし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
⟦{風邪|かぜ}→風邪：02188_kaze⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{休|やす}んだ→休む：00606_yasumu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{追試|ついし}になった。
examples.english: I missed the exam due to a cold, so I have to take a make-up exam.

examples.japanese: {追試|ついし}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{本試験|ほんしけん}→本試験：30251_honshiken⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦{噂|うわさ}→噂：01871_uwasa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There's a rumor that make-up exams are harder than the regular exam.

notes:
{追試|ついし} is an abbreviation of ⟦{追試験|ついしけん}→追試験：06692_tsuishiken⟧. It refers specifically to an exam given to students who missed the original exam for valid reasons such as illness or emergencies.

KEY DISTINCTION:
- {追試|ついし}: make-up exam (for those who missed it with valid reason)
- ⟦{再試験|さいしけん}→再試験：09972_saishiken⟧: retake exam (for those who failed and need another chance)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {追試|ついし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to take a make-up exam
- {追試|ついし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to end up having to take a make-up exam
- {追試|ついし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{届|とど}け{出|で}: a make-up exam request form

RELATED EXAM VOCABULARY:
- ⟦{本試験|ほんしけん}→本試験：30251_honshiken⟧: main/regular exam
- ⟦{期末試験|きまつしけん}→期末試験：06690_kimatsushiken⟧: final exam
- ⟦{中間試験|ちゅうかんしけん}→中間試験：06691_chuukanshiken⟧: midterm exam
- ⟦{追試験|ついしけん}→追試験：06692_tsuishiken⟧: make-up exam (full form)
